queries: WITH product_volume AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(30, 10))) AS volume FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), shares AS (SELECT product_id, volume, volume / NULLIF(SUM(volume) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM product_volume), compared AS (SELECT volume, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(volume) AS combined_order_volume, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_share_above_average FROM compared WHERE share > overall_average_share

WITH product_volume AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS volume FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), shares AS (SELECT product_id, volume, volume / NULLIF(SUM(volume) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM product_volume), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.volume) AS combined_order_volume, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - b.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE s.share > b.average_share

assumptions.assumption: Order volume means the sum of product_quantity, whose VARCHAR values contain numeric quantities; products are those present in Order_Items.

alternatives.interpretation: Order volume means the number of order-item rows for each product.
